title: OIG Exclusions Check (LEIE) for Healthcare
description: Check people, businesses or NPIs against the HHS-OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities, downloaded fresh each run, or list recent exclusions by state. Returns exclusion type and reason, dates, specialty, NPI and address.
eventDescription: One name/NPI checked, or one exclusion listed
why: Medicare and Medicaid won't pay for anything an excluded person touches, so providers must screen staff and vendors monthly. This does that against the live LEIE file.
useCases: Clinics, home-care agencies and pharmacies screening staff monthly

queries.title: Names or NPIs to check
queries.description: 'First Last', 'Last First', a business name, or a 10-digit NPI. Leave empty to list exclusions.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter code, to narrow matches or listings

limits: Dates of birth in the source file are never returned.
Exact normalized name match; confirm any hit against the OIG website before acting.
